'''Giant algae-beds''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] [[Algae/Legends|Algae]] from the [[Cygnus B system]],<ref name="Cantina" /> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The algae-beds were extremely intelligent, with a highly complex [[Brain/Legends|brain]]. Like many such species, considered to be [[super-brain]]s, they were unable to move around independently. As a consequence, the algae-beds had little involvement in the [[galactic community]]. They were known in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Cantina" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Cantina Data">"[[Cantina Communications]]" takes place during the events on [[Tatooine]] shown in {{Film|IV}}, which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], then an inhabitant of the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], had seen a picture of the giant algae-beds.<ref name="Cantina" />

==Behind the scenes==
The giant algae-beds were mentioned in the "[[Cantina Communications]]," short story written by [[John Chesterman]] and first published by [[Paradise Press]] in the [[Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 16|sixteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Official Poster Monthly]]'' magazine<ref name="Cantina" /> which released in [[January]] [[1979]].<ref name="Scan">{{WebCite|url=https://www.theforce.net/timetales/misc/arcana/arcana-1979.asp|text=Scans at Time Tales' Arcana Historica|work=TheForce.net|archivedate=20220626045832}}</ref>
